about: Child of recipe-core. Meets the float-display and unit themes again; adds week-start and leftovers decisions.

tasks.title: Combine milk across units
tasks.prompt: The shopping list shows '1 cup milk' and '250 ml milk' as two lines. Combine quantities of the same item across compatible units into one line, in a sensible unit. Add tests.
expect: shopping_list converts compatible units to one base unit per item before adding

tasks.title: Clean up shopping list numbers
tasks.prompt: The shopping list shows '0.7000000000000001 cup oil'. Fix how quantities are added and displayed.
expect: use exact fractions for quantities, as recipe-core does, to avoid float noise

tasks.title: Start weeks on Monday
tasks.prompt: Plans should always start on the Monday of the current week, whatever day you run it. Decide, implement, test.

tasks.title: Plan leftovers nights
tasks.prompt: Recipes can say 'serves': 4 and the household is 2. Plan the second half as a leftovers night instead of cooking again, and don't buy ingredients twice.
expect: a recipe that serves twice the household covers two nights; shopping counts it once

tasks.title: Let US users start on Sunday
tasks.prompt: US users complain the week starts Monday. Revisit the week-start decision.
expect: week start is configurable: Monday by default, Sunday allowed (qualifies the Monday decision)
